_comment: Catalog seed for ECOMMERCE_SPEC.md, section 3. Not wired to any code yet: it documents the catalog and will feed the file migration to R2.
Prices are the live site prices on 2026-11-22 (they match docs/PRODUCT_COPY.md), in agorot, VAT included. The spec asked for TODO; they were already set, so nothing is invented.
legacy_delivery: how the product is delivered today. external_link = a private link in the back office, d1_file = a file stored in the database, missing = nothing to deliver yet.
files: empty until the files are uploaded to the private R2 bucket (each entry will be {label_he, r2_key}). access_url: TODO means the owner has to supply the link; it must never be committed here.
New products from docs/PRODUCT_COPY.md that do not exist on the site yet are not listed: 30 יום של רישום, חנוכה של אור (price TODO), הזמנה דיגיטלית לחתונה (a service, not a file).
